caption:
Call upon Allah, and He promises to respond

Allah invites you to call upon Him and promises to answer. The only ones this verse warns are those too proud to worship Him.

Surah Ghafir 40:60

What will you ask Allah for before this day ends?

#dua #makedua #surahghafir #answereddua

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: Your Lord says, “Call upon Me; I will respond to you. Those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell, utterly debased.” (Surah Ghafir 40:60)
